verification.webgpuAdapter: SwiftShader; actual WGSL rendering, not hardware performance

measurementNotes: One production renderer at a time; no builds, tests or video encoding during retained samples.
Two-second warmup, then three five-second 90-degree camera orbits.
587x680 drawing buffer, 1x pixels, Apple M4 Pro via ANGLE Metal.
Both renderers use the same seven-species forest rows, dimensions, cameras, wind and shadow inputs.
The historical five-species mesh has its old morphology; banyan/mangrove use opaque leaf-card references with shared growth and refinement.
Draws/s and CPU submission wall time do not measure presented frames or GPU elapsed time.
No mobile, WebGPU performance, winter performance or overview performance claim.
